# Waddah (وضّاح)

> A face and body analysis with a 12-month non-surgical glow-up plan, for men aged 18 and over in Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Bahrain and Oman. Every report is checked by a person before it is delivered. English and Arabic.

## What it is

- The customer takes a few guided photos at home. Measurements of the face and body run on the customer's own device and are compared with published reference ranges.
- A human reviewer checks the results, adds notes and releases the report. AI illustrations of a possible result are labelled as illustrations, not predictions.
- The main deliverable is a 12-month plan for skin, hair, beard and body (habits, routines, training and nutrition). No surgery. A detailed technical analysis is available as an optional extra.
- It is aesthetic and wellness guidance, not medical advice. Anything clinical is referred to a licensed practitioner.
- Women: not available yet; there is a waitlist.

## Prices

One-off report (includes 30 days of membership), then an optional membership. Prices are what the customer pays, VAT included where it applies.

| Country | Report | Monthly membership | 12-month membership |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kuwait | KWD 20 | KWD 5 | KWD 45 |
| Saudi Arabia | SAR 249 | SAR 59 | SAR 549 |
| United Arab Emirates | AED 239 | AED 59 | AED 539 |
| Qatar | QAR 239 | QAR 59 | QAR 529 |
| Bahrain | BHD 25 | BHD 6 | BHD 55 |
| Oman | OMR 25 | OMR 6 | OMR 56 |

The 12-month membership continues monthly after the first 12 months. Memberships can be cancelled at any time. Payment by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay. Other countries: waitlist.

## Privacy

- Photos are deleted 90 days after the report is delivered, or straight away when the customer withdraws photo consent.
- Account data is kept for 24 months after the last activity.
